label: PBI report listener
info: Lake watcher of the PBI report build: file events of the data lake become jobs for the tab PBI report build (global context jobQueue). Also the JOB DONE watch. No API calls.

name: [1] LISTEN: SOURCE FILES
info: STAGE 1 - a subscribe object node on eu_report/pbi_report/source/ (all subfolders) sends one message per file event. The event is kept when it is a MODIFY (new or replaced file) of a plan_opt, line_losses or volume_loss_correction month file; the site and the month come from the path. Deletes and other files are dropped.

name: 1.1 Read source event
[2] LISTEN: REFERENCE FILES
info: STAGE 2 - a subscribe object node on eu_report/reference/ (all subfolders). Kept: a MODIFY of a machine_names, shift_naming, glidepaths or equipment_coding file; the type and the site come from the path.

name: 2.1 Read reference event
[3] LISTEN: COLLECT
info: STAGE 3 - every event is kept in flow context (one entry per site and month, or per reference type and site; repeated events of the same file count once). LISTENERS_ON in this node switches the watcher off (for example during a bulk upload).

name: 3.1 Collect events
[4] LISTEN: JOBS
info: STAGE 4 - a clock looks every 30 s for entries whose wait window is over (120 s for source files, 300 s for reference files, both counted from the first event) and turns them into jobs: months of one site that follow each other become one job; a reference change rebuilds the current month and the months before it (REFERENCE_MONTHS_BACK in node Release due events). The jobs are put in global context jobQueue; node 1.0 of the tab PBI report build takes one every 10 s and runs it like the inject. The debug node shows one line per job.

name: 4.1 Release due events
[5] JOB DONE
info: STAGE 5 - a clock checks every 10 s when the newest log line of the tab PBI report build was written (node Note last log line there, global context lastLog). When no log line came for 30 s the debug node JOB DONE shows one line; the next log line re-arms it. It means "quiet", not "all written": look at the log for errors.

name: 5.1 Check quiet
